credential_delivery.decoder: python-dotenv dotenv_values(stream=memory, interpolate=False); current-owner regular0600 single-link O_NOFOLLOW bounded read; no environment fallback
credential_delivery.observer: Fresh generated credentials remain in the existing helper RAM; never substituted from the private store
credential_delivery.home_resolution: pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_dir; conflicting HOME rejected before any packet read, reservation, credential read or socket; canonical routes must match this template

single_use.retention: Never automatically unlink lease or journal. Any reservation consumes the attempt, including an error before Redis. Existing marker blocks a new exercise; recovery requires separate admission.
single_use.home_override: Rejected; changing HOME cannot choose another native lease/journal/secret directory

detached_invocation.launch_contract: Before any staged imports, Dux runs the pinned preimport verifier with isolated Python (-I -B) from outside the stage, using the independently admitted seven-file manifest and manifest SHA256. Require exit0/STAGE_VERIFIED. Stage must contain exactly the seven pinned regular source/document/template files, no __pycache__, extras, directories or symlinks; current-owner0700 stage. Keep staged bytes unchanged through launch. Then subprocess.Popen once per host using argv -B -E -s, start_new_session=True, stdin=DEVNULL, stdout=current-owner0600 exclusive result.json, stderr=DEVNULL, cwd=stage_directory, env={PATH:/usr/bin:/bin}. No shell/eval or secret argv.
detached_invocation.timeout_policy: Observe detached PID; if not terminal within60 seconds, send SIGTERM once for existing helper cleanup. No automatic retry or forced success. A remaining role is a separately admitted recovery action.
detached_invocation.dependency: Existing python-dotenv; API verified on Mini, Pro compatibility must be checked by Dux without reading credentials. No install.
detached_invocation.self_check_boundary: Runtime source checks occur after imports and do not establish pre-import integrity. The external pre-import verifier checks the stage; installed interpreter/dependency integrity and concurrent same-UID tampering are outside its guarantee.
